title: Finding (the contract's clauses on an OCSF finding)
description: What the contract adds to every finding a module writes: a rule key and at most one label. A finding also validates against its class's OCSF export; this schema checks only the contract's clauses and lets every other field through.

rule.description: The rule key: printable ASCII without spaces, double quotes or backslashes, 1 to 200 characters. It names the rule, never one finding, and holds no captured data

class_uid.description: An OCSF Findings class. Incident Finding (2005) has no finding_info and is not checked here

labels.description: The finding's label, when it has one: benign or real from the user's decision, routine or test from code at creation
